newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln in NCDs on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln in NCDs on Wednesday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday it would issue T$5 billion in three-month negotiable certificates of deposits later in the day.
Bids will close at 3 p.m. (0700 GMT), a central bank official said.
The central bank's recent NCD issues were seen widely in the market as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts say has been fuelling the sizzling stock market rally.
The central bank, however, denied that this was the case, saying the bank was acting purely in response to the liquidity situation.
Partly due to the central bank's attitude, the stock index had fallen for five straight sessions last week, dealers said.
But the index rebounded on Monday and Tuesday. At mid-morning on Wednesday, the index was up 2.03 percent at 8,601.87 points.
